findings.summary: unscoped decision rows carry no marker for whole-plan scope
findings.text: an open or gated decision that names no sections emits no 'sections' key at all, so the row cannot express the '(or the whole plan)' half of section 15's deliverable: a consumer of the /crew rows, including the crew page section 16 governs, cannot tell a whole-plan wait from a row whose sections field is simply absent.

findings.summary: crew rows re-walk mounts instead of reading the roadmap report list
findings.text: _waiting_decision_rows re-walks every mounted project's plans directory and re-derives the rows from freshly parsed plan state rather than reading the roadmap report's own waiting_decisions list, so the rows are computed on two independently parsed inputs; the parity case builds one project with one plan, so a multi-project ordering or membership divergence between the remains untested.

justifications.durability: tests/test_every_surface_lists_open_decisions.py:154 asserts summary_rows == crew_rows, comparing two independent code paths (the roadmap report versus serve._crew_plan_state), and the recorded negative control reddens on removing the summary key; it does not show the parity comparison catching a same-shape divergence, since the control raises KeyError instead.
justifications.evidence: both gate arms are recorded in the reviewed run's manifest with revision, failure_ids and an EXIT= log line, and the head arm ran at 496fdf6a70efa5908251a7c84ff029566e465aa4 (the code commit) rather than the manifest head df765f99, whose only added content is the evidence fragment.
justifications.fit: reckon/roadmap.py:1096 and reckon/serve.py:698 follow the surrounding module idiom and name mechanisms rather than plan labels, though waiting_decision_rows (reckon/roadmap.py:1109) and _waiting_decision_rows (reckon/serve.py:808) differ only by a leading underscore.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/mcp_views.py:3519-3520 exposes the derived rows as the summary view's open_decisions and its count, and reckon/serve.py:3126 carries the same rows on /crew, the goal's two named surfaces.
justifications.reuse: the row derivation extends its owner reckon/roadmap.py:_decision_rows with the waiting_context option rather than forking it, but reckon/serve.py:808 duplicates the fleet-wide mount walk _build_roadmap already performs, and reckon/mcp_views.py:2495 already owns a narrower enumerate-a-plan's-open-decisions helper.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 9a9492e0a..df765f99a --stat shows only reckon/roadmap.py, reckon/mcp_views.py, reckon/serve.py, tests/test_every_surface_lists_open_decisions.py and the evidence fragment, all within the declared write paths.
